notes.title: Update V0.1.1.8
notes.content: [p]Thank you for playing Undying Harvest! I know it's been a while, but I'm glad to bring the next update. This update mostly consists of small changes to make the game feel a bit better, with some minor bug fixes, balancing, and quality of life features. [/p][p]I have some big plans for the near future to really spruce the game up, make sure to follow me on Twitter to keep up to date with what I'm currently up to![/p][p][url="https://x.com/CSBSoftware"]https://x.com/CSBSoftware[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Release V0.1.1.8:[/p][p]-Implemented an input buffer[/p][p]-Implemented an indicator that lets you know how much money you received from harvesting a plant[/p][p]-Fixed invulnerable mushroom enemies[/p][p]-Enemies no longer give money on death[/p][p]-Mushroom enemies summoned by the Fungus boss will now no longer be able to spawn under the player[/p][p]-Temporarily removed Big Jack (he will return)[/p][p]-Reduced the purchase amount of the first plot upgrade[/p][p]-Added new boss bonus, rewarding you for farming when there's a boss[/p]

notes.title: Update V0.1.1.7
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Undying Harvest! I’m thrilled to bring you this spine-chilling update just in time for the Spooky Season! With the monstrous Grave Beast and the menacing Lich now lurking on the farm, along with some eerie gameplay tweaks, there’s plenty to dive into. Enjoy, and may your harvest be… undying!

Release 0.1.1.7:
-Changed weapon upgrades from boss drops to purchasable upgrades
-Added 2 new bosses, the Lich and the Gravebeast
-Fixed bug where sometimes 2 lives would be lost instead of 1
-Fixed ghosted enemy issue
-Added upgrades to keep crops wet and remove weeds permanently

notes.title: Update V0.1.1.6
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Undying Harvest! I hope everyone's ready for the Steam Summer Sale right around the corner. This update adds a new difficulty system as well as a new boss. Get ready!

Release 0.1.1.6:
-Added difficulty Selection
-On easy difficulty, you have 5 lives
-On normal difficulty, you have 3 lives, and the time you spend regenerating your health is increased on every down
-On hard you have a single life
-Added new boss, the Spectral Wraith

notes.title: Update V0.1.1.5
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Undying Harvest! I hope you are enjoying the Steam Farming Fest 2024, this update adds quite a bit of content, including the first actual boss with its own unique boss fight!

Release 0.1.1.5:
-Enemies spawn on a more irregular basis (no longer timed intervals)
-Every few zombies will have a bit increased health
-Added swamp creature enemies
-Added mushrom enemies
-Added Fungus Boss
-Fixed "Upgrades Available" appearing after $50 even though no upgrades were available
-Fixed invincible enemy bug if the game was paused while that enemy was in its dying animation

notes.title: Update V0.1.1.4
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Undying Harvest! Just a small update fixing a few small things.

Release 0.1.1.4:
-Added Zombie spawning animation
-Fixed Big Jack's health bar on subsequent visits

notes.title: Update V0.1.1.3
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Undying Harvest! Added a few quality of life changes around Big Jack as well as integrated Steam Achievements and Stats!

Release 0.1.1.3:
-Added additional spawn points for Big Jack
-Added tips in the pause menu
-Added Steam achievements
-Added Steam stat tracking

notes.title: Update V0.1.1.2
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Undying Harvest! Adding some improvements surrounding our guy Big Jack, making him a bit more of a challenge!

Release 0.1.1.2:
-Added a health bar for Big Jack
-Temporarily removed fences to overhaul enemy movement around them
-Increased Big Jack's health and knockback resistance

notes.title: Update V0.1.1.1
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Undying Harvest, here are the patch notes for the first update.

[list]
[*] removed tax system
[*] added boss system to replace taxes
[*] current boss is an infinitely scaling larger zombie, gaining more stats each time it comes back
[*] instead of game over due to not paying taxes, now if you go down while the boss is on your farm, you'll get a game over
[*] added new upgrade system after boss kills
[/list]
